finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts::`isemptybulletline` also accepts `*` and `+`, so a lone `*`/`+` after a paragraph silently loses the literal character
evidence:
Verified in the supplied `list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts`: `isEmptyBulletLine` (line ~39) accepts 0x2a and 0x2b in addition to DASH, and `wrappedList` returns true for any of them in silent/paragraph mode, bypassing upstream markdown-it's `isTerminatingParagraph` empty-item guard; the non-silent pass then builds `
`. The replaced `lheading` only ever special-cases `marker === DASH && runLength === 1`, and upstream lheading only handles `-`/`=`, so `*`/`+` are indeed unrelated to the #517 setext ambiguity — this is genuine scope creep, undocumented in notes.md ("a lone single `-`") and untested in preview.test.ts. I rate it minor rather than major because the resulting render (an empty bullet) is the same intuitive outcome the plugin deliberately adopts for `-`, so the "lost" `*` becomes a bullet marker rather than vanishing entirely; confidence is medium because I could not execute markdown-it and relied on knowledge of its list-rule internals.
